question: How is the dissolution form of the great nyāsa performed?
premises: This rite is identified as dissolution.
It is called the great nyāsa.
It uses sixteen seed-syllables in sequence.
inference: The dissolution great nyāsa is performed in order with sixteen seed-syllables.
